source.title: Herring Gull 1.wav
source.author: Canardo55
source.notes: 48 kHz 24-bit stereo, 33 s, already edited: digital silence around 14 s of one herring gull (7.9-22.3 s, calls 700-3400 Hz). Its long call (a long note, then a run of short 'ha-ha' notes) and two later calls. A motorboat comes closer from about 18.5 s (100-400 Hz up to 20 dB, reaching 1.5 kHz in the gaps): the call after it is left out, and the 600 Hz high-pass takes what is left of the engine.
